title: Metric pack preview: every thin row says how many more and roughly when
deviations_from_card: (1) metricPackPreview.ts + its test are named metricPackPreviewModel.ts / metricPackPreviewModel.test.ts: the card's metricPackPreview.ts and MetricPackPreview.tsx differ only in case, which tsc rejects (TS1149) on this case-insensitive checkout. Same content and role. (2) Series is catalogs -> docs -> perf -> feat (tests ship in the feat commit): the new cases import new modules and new catalog keys, so a test-only commit could not be green; the 18 cases (6 horizon, 6 pack, 6 view model; covering all 8 acceptance lines) were written first and run red. (3) The need sentence is resolved at build time into need.note (like basis) and the Markdown caveat appends it verbatim; the preview renders the same note, so the JSON, the file and the screen share one string. (4) Only hires have a measured pace (momentum); actions and NPS responses report no-pace; capacity reports not-accruing. A not-measurable row whose sample already clears its floor carries need:null. (5) buildMetricPackStrings gained an optional locale param (date formatting); metric-pack-strings.ts passes it. (6) The window hint offers 'Use all time' (calls the header's setDays(null)). The slot-A DeltaChip 'why withheld' gap was not in this write set and is left open.
notes: Acceptance 8 of 8.
